mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLACESAVE_TB ( addr1, addr2, area_code, content_id, content_type_id, first_image, first_image2, mapx, mapy, sigungu_code, tel, title, zipcode, overview ) VALUES ( #{placeInfo.addr1}, #{placeInfo.addr2}, #{placeInfo.areaCode}, #{placeInfo.contentId}, #{placeInfo.contentTypeId}, #{placeInfo.firstImage}, #{placeInfo.firstImage2}, #{placeInfo.mapX}, #{placeInfo.mapY}, #{placeInfo.sigunguCode}, #{placeInfo.tel}, #{placeInfo.title}, #{placeInfo.zipcode}, #{placeInfo.overview} );
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PLACESAVE_TB AS PS LEFT JOIN USER_PLACE_TB AS UP ON PS.place_id = UP.user_place_id WHERE UP.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY regdate desc
